description: The pages the real-sites round visits with one browser at a time (scripts/run_real_sites.py), judged by scripts/judge_real_sites.py: the published wrapper against stock Firefox driven by stock Playwright, on the same runner. Only URL, marker and class are kept here.

fields.classes: The kinds of page a site may be.
fields.sites: The list, at most 20 sites and at most 4 of the class protetta. The judge asks for information from half of them, rounded up (8 of 15): there is no minimum written in this file, and a file that has one is not a list.
fields.id: Per site. A short unique name made of lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. It keys the cells of both browsers.
fields.url: Per site. The page to open, https, without a login. The document is the page the status is read from.
fields.marker: Per site. A CSS selector that matches something only when the real page arrived (not an error page, not a block page, not a consent wall).
fields.class: Per site. One of the classes: calma (a quiet page), giornale (a newspaper full of advertising), negozio (a shop), applicazione (a single-page application or a search), protetta (a page behind protection).
